parameters.query: INSERT INTO candidate_applications (candidate_name, email, match_score, experience_years, status) VALUES ('{{ $json.candidate_name }}', '{{ $json.email }}', {{ $json.match_score }}, {{ $json.experience_years }}, 'screened') RETURNING *;

parameters.subject: =Interview Invitation - {{ $json.job_title }}
parameters.text: =Hi {{ $json.candidate_name }}, congratulations! Your profile scored {{ $json.match_score }}/100. Please select an interview slot here: {{ $json.booking_link }}
